# Terrastate

> Terrastate is a free, Planetarion-style grand strategy game that runs in the web browser. You lead one nation against 300 AI nations on a world map, form alliances and fight for the Nexus, the one region that decides the season. No account, no download, no ads, no pay-to-win. Romaterra is the same game set in the age of Rome, and Ironfront in Europe at war in 1944. Made by Wim Kamphorst, a hobby developer from the Netherlands.

Current version: 9.3. The game is updated regularly. Language: English. Platforms: any modern browser on desktop or phone; installable and playable offline.

## Play
- [Play Terrastate](https://playterrastate.nl/play.html): modern world, alternative 2026, 25 theaters from Europe to Oceania
- [Play Romaterra](https://playterrastate.nl/romaterra.html): the age of Rome, from Hesperia to Serica
- [Play Ironfront](https://playterrastate.nl/ironfront.html): Europe at war in 1944 with invented nations; hold 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors
- [Ironfront on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/ironfront)
- [Terrastate on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/terrastate)
- [Romaterra on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/romaterra)

## Good to know
- Board games (October 2026): each world also has a board game of hidden ranks for one opponent, free in the browser: Hidden Command (https://playterrastate.nl/command/terrastate.html), Veiled Legions (https://playterrastate.nl/command/romaterra.html) and Sealed Orders (https://playterrastate.nl/command/ironfront.html). A 9 by 9 board, armies set up in secret, sealed orders for extra points, four computer commanders on four levels or two players on one screen. About 15 to 30 minutes a battle.
- Update 9.3 (October 2026), The world around you, for Terrastate, Romaterra and Ironfront: the Report page shows in at most five lines what needs you, what happened at home, what changed next door and what the world is talking about; the paper tells real stories of the day; regions that changed hands near you get a ring on the map and can be replayed; heavy fighting pushes some raw materials up a little; a neighbour that falls can send refugees; routine world news is folded into one line per turn.
- Update 9.2 (October 2026), Allies that fight with you, for Terrastate, Romaterra and Ironfront: before a joint strike you see which AI allies join, your force together and your odds; allies join when the odds are good and say why when they stay home; an ally can propose a joint strike; as alliance leader you pick the target at the war council; an S.O.S. gets a real answer and the alliance chat is quieter.
- Update 9.1 (October 2026), Supply, Seasons and Veterans, for Ironfront: supply lines (an army fights 5% weaker in another sector and 15% weaker on another front, halved at a Capital Sector, cancelled by supply trucks), seasons and weather (spring mud, summer air power, autumn rain, winter cold, 40 turns each) and named divisions that earn up to three veteran stars (+4% each). The AI nations play by the same rules. Terrastate and Romaterra are unchanged.
- Update 9.0 (October 2026), Everything in its place: every piece of information sits on the screen it is about (army on Armed Forces, buildings on Production, defence on Homeland, the world on Rankings), panels no longer repeat across screens, and the menu has one button per screen.
- Update 8.1 (October 2026), Nine Games: a board game of hidden ranks in every world (Hidden Command, Veiled Legions, Sealed Orders) at playterrastate.nl/command/, so each world has three free games, plus fixes from a full test round.
- Update 8.0 (October 2026), Solid Ground, for all three games: weak nations can break apart into land to take; holding the prize earns hold points over the whole season (two per turn in the Last Battle) and the most points wins, unless a nation wins outright first; a coalition forms against a runaway leader; one turn report replaces pop-ups; phone screens use cards with big buttons; Romaterra plays on a map of the Roman world and Ironfront on a map of Europe in 1944; saved games, the season end and the end screen are fixed. The mini games link to their grand strategy game and have a daily battle.
- Tactics games (October 2026): each world also has a short turn-based hex tactics game, free in the browser: Terrastate: Conquer (https://playterrastate.nl/tactics/terrastate.html), Romaterra: Imperium (https://playterrastate.nl/tactics/romaterra.html) and Ironfront: D-Day (https://playterrastate.nl/tactics/ironfront.html). Overview: https://playterrastate.nl/tactics/
- Patch 7.4 (October 2026), Clear Screens, for all three games: regions outside your home sector get half of your home army as defence plus the troops stationed there; every screen starts with what matters most (Homeland with the attacks on you, Nearby with your army and nearest targets, Diplomacy with your wars and pacts, Economy with what you make); information shown twice is shown once; background blocks fold under More on this screen; the website has a new front page and logo.
- Update 7.3 (October 2026), Know Your Odds, for all three games: unclaimed ground shows the strength of its neutral garrison and your chance; the launch panel offers ready-made forces (enough to take it, half, everything) with their odds; a hopeless attack or a blind attack on a nation you never scouted asks first; defend your own ground or an ally with a quarter, half or most of your home army in one tap; quick recruit in Armed Forces; unit lists no longer cut off; a calmer battle result screen.
- Update 7.2 (October 2026), Battle Moments, for all three games: after every battle of yours a result screen opens with victory or defeat, the losses of both sides, the full report and what to do next (garrison and calm new ground, plan a new attack, strike back after holding); the latest battle stays on Home for a few turns; battle reports come first in Reports with an unread dot; a Field Manual page about holding new ground; turns as fast as before 7.1.
- Update 7.1 (October 2026), Living World, for all three games: AI alliances take in lone nations and can unite through the normal merger, so alliances differ in size; the greatest powers form blocs with allied pacts; when one alliance stays ahead, the next ones form a coalition against it and strike together, and break up once it falls back; allied partners join a war when their ally is attacked; a nation that is hit strikes back, most of all while the attacker's army is away; fewer and longer wars that are really fought; a world card on Diplomacy. The AI uses the same commands and limits as players.
- Update 7.0 (October 2026), Command Desk, for all three games: one Front card on Home for each attack on your ground (your defence against the attack on the way, Defend, Scan, Recall plus shield, and in Ironfront the battle orders); one-line alerts on other screens; each screen starts with its own content; extra attack panels folded; END TURN in the middle of the phone bottom bar; a Share button (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, copy) with a picture card on battle reports and at the end of a season; Messages renamed Comms with the world forum; optional background alerts; in the live world, alliance chat links that only members see; a build plan (up to 5 builds that start when affordable, also while away); for the live world, standing orders and plans run server-side, a friendly human check for script-like timing, no convoys between accounts on one connection, and a public read-only API (/api/public/world); many bug fixes.
- Patch 6.1 (October 2026), Act Where You Read, for all three games: action buttons in warnings, the alert bar and reports; Defend in one press (scan, and field works in Ironfront); recall plus shield in one press; standing orders, off until switched on (return garrisons, auto-scan, retreat line, pacify, keep army at a size, research plan); market buying without command points; scans 250 and scouting 200 influence, influence income grows with regions; non-aggression pacts with computer neighbours in solo; small border probes from computer neighbours in solo.
- Ironfront (October 2026), the third era: Europe at war in 1944 with invented nations, leaders and flags. Win by holding 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors with a GHQ Bunker for 12 ticks. Its own battle layer: battle orders every tick (Assault, Barrage or Flank against Dig in, Counter-attack or Ambush; the side that guesses right gets +25% that tick), field works (trenches 1 tick, minefield 2, bunker 3) on a threatened region, incoming armies shown as radio traffic with a size estimate, feints that look three times bigger on weaker radar and turn back before landing, and allied help that counts half when it arrives after the battle started.
- Update 6.0 (October 2026), Solid Ground: saves in a much larger browser store (moved over by itself, the old copy kept as a reserve), no slow compression after every order, faster turns, and a "Calculating turn" bar on END TURN.
- Update 5.0 (October 2026), Every Turn Counts: AI allies defend commanders who play, a fair defender's bounty, prestige projects for a full treasury (influence only, no military power), a sharper Warlord with the same resources, one clear comeback bonus capped at +150% production, a shorter Home and a calmer phone screen.
- Genre: grand strategy, turn-based strategy, 4X, browser game, single-player against AI.
- Free and non-commercial: no payments, no ads, no account.
- Turn-based, or auto-play at 1x, 5x or 20x. Seasons: Quick (200 turns), Standard (400) or Epic (840). Difficulty: Recruit, Veteran or Warlord. Six campaign scenarios plus a Veteran round.
- New players get Field Training: five small tasks and a war game that explains the first battle.
- Every season a personal AI rival seeks you out, and returns next season. Phase goals, 23 national events with follow-ups, optional season rules (Cold Peace, Fast Nexus, Iron Wall).
- Fair AI: computer nations pay exactly what the player pays and only know what they have scouted.
- Season 0: the single-player game is the training ground for the live multiplayer world. The live world opens when 100 commanders have joined the waitlist on Discord (https://discord.gg/TRgERXq4u). Season 0 players are marked as Founding Commanders.
- Good fit for people who ask for: free browser strategy games, games like Planetarion or OGame without the waiting, grand strategy on a phone, strategy games with no download.
